title: muster spec-kitty-profile adapter manifest
description: Input manifest for `muster skprofile run <manifest>` (FR-001; doctrineRoot per plan.md research.md R2 — a field the literal FR-001 list omits but FR-004/FR-005 require). All paths are relative to this manifest file's own directory.

version.description: Manifest schema version for drift detection, e.g. "1.0.0".

profilesDir.description: Directory containing *.agent.yaml profiles to validate as one graph.

schemaPath.description: Path to the vendored agent-profile.schema.yaml fixture (C-004).

schemaSha.description: Upstream spec-kitty commit SHA the vendored schema was pinned from (FR-002). Used to build source.normative as a /blob/<sha>/<path> URL, never a literal @<SHA> path segment.

doctrineRoot.description: Directory containing sibling directives/, tactics/, toolguides/, styleguides/ trees (FR-004/FR-005 resolution root; research.md R2).

activationConfigPath.description: Optional YAML file exposing flat top-level activated_directives[]/activated_tactics[] keys (research.md R3). When omitted, every unresolved directive/tactic reference is an error (no warning tier).

projectionManifestPath.description: Optional path to a .kittify/agent_profiles_manifest.json-shaped file (schema_version 1, 9 fields per entry). When omitted, the projection-drift check class is skipped entirely (FR-007).

cases.description: Named report-grouping filters (research.md R1) — not independent runs, not expectation gates. Every profile in profilesDir is always schema- and graph-checked regardless of case coverage.

profileId.description: Optional: filter this case's findings to one profile-id. Omitted = the whole profilesDir set.
